text: Southridge Video: archive storage bill jumped 30% in March, about $18k over forecast. Olu Bankole (Head of Post-Production) wants options to tier cold assets.
Draft a quick note to Olu saying we'll come back with tiering options and a savings estimate by Friday.

Tailspin call with Omar Haddad (CTO) and Grace Liu (Engineering Manager). The API migration can't make phase 1: their SSO integration isn't ready, gateway rate limits would throttle the cutover, and data residency for EU customers isn't signed off. Omar is fine pushing it to phase 2 in May as long as we document the blockers.
Draft a follow-up email to Tailspin's CTO, Omar Haddad, about moving the API migration to phase 2 in May; mention the three blockers: SSO, rate limits, data residency.
Wingtip: Diego Ramírez signed the 24-month renewal, PO to follow next week. Kickoff for the new service tier is 4 May.
Vandelay Industries wants us to scope EDI links with two new freight forwarders, live before peak season in September. Marisol Ortega (Supply Chain Director) is the sponsor.
Prep a one-paragraph scope summary for the Vandelay EDI work that I can paste into the CRM.
Fourth Coffee: Leilani Kahale (Ops Director) wants the store Wi-Fi refresh to start with the 12 airport kiosks, they have the worst card-reader dropouts.
Trey Research: Dr. Ama Owusu wants a 30-min call Friday on HPC burst options. Need someone from our cloud team on it.
Resend yesterday's Tailspin email, but make the second paragraph shorter.

expect.should: Gives a revised version of yesterday's follow-up email to Tailspin's CTO, Omar Haddad, about moving the API migration to phase 2 in May, still covering the three blockers (SSO, rate limits, data residency), with a shorter second paragraph.
expect.should_not: Says it can't find or doesn't have the previous email, asks the user to paste it, or writes an email to a different recipient or about a different topic.
